text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hawawa...! Rice-chan, you're sparkling...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's so sparkly...! So this is the 
"Valentine Fair"...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Wah! There's chocolate ice cream over 
there! Carrot chocolate too! H-Hawawa...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, any of them is fine. You see, I 
brought all my allowance today...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Rice, you're all fired up! Alright, 
let's eat a whole bunch today~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah. This is the stuff I got as a gift the 
other day. It was actually pretty tasty.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
? Yukino? Don't you need to pick out some 
chocolates?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes?! I'll pick! I'll pick, but-cha 
see...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinkin' how you get chocolates 
from so many people, City-san... Even if 
you didn't have mine...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Do you really think so?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I mean, aren't you happy just receiving 
something on Valentine's Day? It feels 
like your memories with that person are 
growing too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I want some. Chocolates from Yukino, that 
is. What about you, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
! I-I want some chocolate from you too, 
City-san!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So swee~t... So tast~y... I'm so fu~ll...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ! Urara-chan, are you sleepy already?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. We'll continue this another 
time then. Ah, excuse me... waiter!

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: Yes, what can I help you with?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um... could you please gift-wrap that 
carrot chocolate from earlier?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, to go, please. ...Urara-chan said she 
wanted to eat more.

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes. I'll get it ready then.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan. Can you get on my back?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Hmm... what about Valentine's...?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm fine. Let's pick this up later, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Happy Valentine's.
